outreach.subject: Longer Warranties for Capital Wraps' Vehicle Graphics
outreach.body:
Hi Keoni,

I noticed Capital Wraps positions itself around durability and lifespan for vehicle wraps, fleet graphics, and large-format signage — attributes that matter most when your work is exposed to sun, weather, and road grime for years at a time.

DuPont Tedlar overlaminate films are engineered to protect printed graphics from UV degradation and abrasion, which lets applicators like Capital Wraps confidently offer longer warranties on wraps and outdoor signage without added risk.

Would it be useful to send over a technical data sheet and a few durability comparison samples? Happy to set up a short 15-minute call if you'd like to walk through fit for your current product lines.

Best,
[Your Name]
DuPont Tedlar Graphics & Signage

outreach.body: Jamie, I noticed NUtec markets its UV-curable ranges around durability themes like UV and chemical resistance for outdoor signage and fleet graphics. outreach.subject: Extending outdoor graphic warranties with Tedlar
outreach.body: Jean, I noticed NUtec markets its UV-curable and solvent ink ranges around durability themes like UV resistance and lifespan for outdoor signage and fleet graphics. Since printed graphics are only as durable as the topcoat protecting them, some ink and media manufacturers pair their formulations with Tedlar PVF overlaminate films, which hold color and gloss through years of direct sun exposure. This lets converters and printers using NUtec inks underwrite longer warranties on finished graphics. Would it be worth a short call to see if a Tedlar-protected construction could complement your ink lines for signage and transit graphic customers? outreach.body: Latrese, Briteline's line of banner and wrap films positions you well for exterior signage, vehicle wrap, and wall/floor graphics where durability claims matter to customers. Given Briteline's focus on chemical resistance and lifespan in its product messaging, I thought this might be relevant to your overlaminate strategy. outreach.subject: Extending warranty life on Briteline exterior graphics
outreach.body: Jim, I noticed Briteline's line of exterior signage and wrap films is built around durability claims like chemical resistance and long service life. Many printers using standard overlaminates still see hazing or fading from UV and road chemicals within a couple years, which caps the warranties they can offer. DuPont Tedlar overlaminate films are engineered to resist solvents, cleaners, and road chemicals without hazing, letting manufacturers back their graphics with longer, more confident warranties.
